title: Warcore Balance Patch 1.0.2 - Shock Infantry & Armor Tuning
summary: Recalibrates base Astartes kinetic momentum, enhances Kasrkin armor penetration, and adjusts Ork Choppa mass scaling to improve mid-tier melee counterplay.

unitDeltas.tacticalRationale: Increased armor rating to better reflect ceramite plate resistance against small arms volley fire.
Slightly compresses the charge duration to improve shock assault responsiveness without breaking collision grids.
Enhanced hot-shot lasgun penetration against monstrous creatures and power armored units.
Reduced cost to allow larger Imperial Guard defensive line formations in competitive matches.
Increased health pool to compensate for low armor rating against high rate-of-fire weapons.
